marketLayer.title: US & HK Artificial Intelligence & Semiconductor Hardware
marketLayer.fact: Major cloud service providers (CSPs) increased hardware capital expenditure guidance while Asian supply chains reported elevated wafer utilization rates for high-performance computing nodes.
marketLayer.inference: Short-term momentum favors upstream semiconductor equipment and advanced packaging manufacturers across US and HK tech lists, reinforcing high valuation support.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Enterprise ROI timeline for downstream AI application deployment and potential adjustments to international trade regulatory frameworks.

marketLayer.title: US Macroeconomic Rates & Global Liquidity Sentiment
marketLayer.fact: US core inflation and labor market data indicate stabilizing economic activity, shifting interest rate futures towards pricing in monetary easing later in the year.
marketLayer.inference: Easing long-term Treasury yields reduce discount-rate pressures on high-duration growth equities, facilitating sustained capital inflows into foreign and HK-listed tech shares.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential sticky headline inflation resurgence driven by energy commodity fluctuations.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Internet & E-Commerce Sector Repricing
marketLayer.fact: Leading HK-listed platform enterprises expanded disciplined capital allocation programs, emphasizing share buybacks and margin optimization over subsidies.
marketLayer.inference: Enhanced free cash flow generation and shareholder return yields provide a solid valuation floor for large-cap Hang Seng Tech constituents.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Overall pace of domestic retail consumption growth and competitive intensity in local services.
